name: Gas engines
principle: Spark-ignited or dual-fuel reciprocating engines in the 1 to 20 MW class generate power from natural gas or biogas. Wärtsilä's 50SG makes about 18.4 MW at 50.2% electrical efficiency, connects to the grid within 30 seconds and reaches full load in under 2 minutes in a fast start.

suppliers.name: JEREH
suppliers.product: INNIO Jenbacher/Waukesha authorized integrator; 3 kVA-3,300 kVA gas gensets and distributed energy (Jereh Distributed Energy)

reference_plants.name: PLTD Pesanggaran, Bali (PT Indonesia Power)
reference_plants.status: in operation; delivered 2015 and began on HFO, primarily LNG since July 2016 (largest engine-based power plant in Indonesia)
